cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Image-Based Lighting (IBL) specular probes for rough dielectrics (rubber, clay, concrete, matte plastic) and brushed metals in UE5, Filament, and Three.js
Explaining why evaluating Schlick Fresnel with macroscopic N·V instead of microfacet V·H creates a 24.48× radioactive white rim on rough surfaces
Factoring F₀ out of the hemispherical BRDF integral into two pre-integrated channels: F₀ · scale(N·V, r) + bias(N·V, r)
Replacing 192-point per-pixel numerical quadrature with O(1) closed-form DFG polynomial fits or a 2D RG16F LUT
not_for: Mirror-smooth chrome surfaces (r = 0.0) where V·H = N·V and macroscopic Schlick Fresnel is already exact
Pure Lambertian diffuse irradiance probes without a specular microfacet lobe
Neural environment map estimation or inverse rendering networks
Unlit wireframe or flat-color CAD overlays
